title: Unlearning as Ablation: Toward a Falsifiable Benchmark for Generative Scientific Discovery
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes a conceptual benchmark called 'unlearning-as-ablation' to test whether AI models can constructively generate new scientific knowledge (like theorems or algorithms) after all related information has been removed from them.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith as it is not a subject of the research.
